title: Chaffin 1990: csa anatomical of quadratus lumborum at L3-L4 (F, supine)

imaging.modality: CT (Technicare 1440 HPS), bone protocol 130 kV, 1-mm slices
imaging.plane: transverse scans perpendicular to the table at the disc levels (identified on scout view); x/y axes rotated so y passes through disc centroid and spinous process
imaging.posture_detail: supine, knees and hips flexed to minimise lordosis

quantity.name: csa_anatomical
quantity.definition: anatomical cross-sectional area of the muscle in the image plane (as cut, not corrected for fibre direction)

source.authors: Chaffin DB, Redfern MS, Erig M, Goldstein SA

how_to_simulate: Pose the model supine (lying; lordosis as when lying, no gravity load on trunk).

Select all quadratus lumborum fascicles whose path crosses the plane at L3-L4 (transverse scans perpendicular to the table at the disc levels (identified on scout view); x/y axes rotated so y passes through disc centroid and spinous process), one side.
Sum their PCSA; divide each PCSA by cos(angle between fascicle and plane normal) to get anatomical CSA.
Compare the one-side total with the measured mean +/- SD (bilateral sums are labelled side=bilateral_sum).

subject_model.source: Table 1 (whole sample) and Table 3 (disc area at this level)

protocol.notes: Uncorrected CT area. Torso area by level: 443/509/576 cm2. cm2 -> mm2.

extraction.check_notes: All values verified cell by cell on rendered pages 12-13 (layout text had OCR errors).
